messages.content: Hello! Today we are working on pointers in C. To begin, what is a pointer variable and what does it hold?
sorry, I haven't really understood pointers in C at all. Can you explain again from scratch step by step?
A pointer is a variable that stores the memory address of another variable. For example, int *ptr = &x stores the address of x in ptr.
I'm still lost. Can you give an example of the difference between * and &? I don't understand why we need two symbols.
& is the address-of operator, so &x gives the location of x. * is the dereference operator, so *ptr accesses the value stored at that address.
Every time I try this in a problem, my program crashes with a segmentation fault. Can you explain again why? I don't get this.
A segmentation fault happens when a pointer points to an unallocated or invalid memory location.
